uniform_vs_selective.expectation: in uniform mode the count passed to p_elevate is the eligible element count, so tet10+hex20 should equal it; a shortfall means elements were rejected and the row is not full parity with Gmsh
uniform_vs_selective.shortfall_is_expected_on_curved_families: p_elevate declines a promotion when an inherited curved edge node would make the promoted element invalid at a quadrature point, so a shortfall is expected where order-2 rims are already conformed to the B-rep (tube, stepped_shaft, box_hole bores). promotion.order_pairing: TRUE PARITY: uniform promotion, directly comparable with the order-2 Gmsh rows.

uniform_vs_selective.expectation: in uniform mode the count passed to p_elevate is the eligible element count, so tet10+hex20 should equal it; a shortfall means elements were rejected and the row is not full parity with Gmsh
uniform_vs_selective.shortfall_is_expected_on_curved_families: p_elevate declines a promotion when an inherited curved edge node would make the promoted element invalid at a quadrature point, so a shortfall is expected where order-2 rims are already conformed to the B-rep (tube, stepped_shaft, box_hole bores). It is a real limit on parity, not a defect.

promotion.order_pairing: TRUE PARITY: uniform promotion, directly comparable with the order-2 Gmsh rows.

uniform_vs_selective.expectation: in uniform mode the count passed to p_elevate is the eligible element count, so tet10+hex20 should equal it; a shortfall means elements were rejected and the row is not full parity with Gmsh
uniform_vs_selective.shortfall_is_expected_on_curved_families: p_elevate declines a promotion when an inherited curved edge node would make the promoted element invalid at a quadrature point, so a shortfall is expected where order-2 rims are already conformed to the B-rep (tube, stepped_shaft, box_hole bores). It is a real limit on parity, not a defect.

uniform_vs_selective.expectation: in uniform mode the count passed to p_elevate is the eligible element count, so tet10+hex20 should equal it; a shortfall means elements were rejected and the row is not full parity with Gmsh
uniform_vs_selective.shortfall_is_expected_on_curved_families: p_elevate declines a promotion when an inherited curved edge node would make the promoted element invalid at a quadrature point, so a shortfall is expected where order-2 rims are already conformed to the B-rep (tube, stepped_shaft, box_hole bores). It is a real limit on parity, not a defect.
